notes:
Written by ea-08-x on 2026-10-25 from eight pages (three above the usual page budget: a long-lived state, 1916-1932, with three phases). Cliopatria has no Fengtian row; its 'Republic of China' row draws the whole country (ea-08-c) and Manchuria 1932-1945 sits in 'Empire of Japan' (jk-01), so the renderer should draw the shapes here over those rows.

Settled: the sequence Liaoning (1916), Manchuria (1918), Zhili/Beijing/Tianjin (Nov 1924), four provinces by August 1925, Beijing June 1926, the loss in 1928, the Northeast Army in Peking in September 1930, and the Japanese invasion in 1931-32. The ROC dossier (ea-08-c) carries the vassal_start of 1930 and vassal_end of September 1931 for 'Fengtian clique (Zhang Xueliang)'; the allegiance to Nanjing is dated 29 December 1928 on the Northern Expedition page, earlier than that dossier's 1930.

Not settled: (1) the Fengtian page's infobox says 'Active: 1911-1928'; this dossier follows the page's text that the clique governed Manchuria to 1931; (2) the extent of the Northeast Army's holdings in North China after September 1930 (the Central Plains page gives only Peking) and until when (Zhang Xueliang page not opened); (3) who held Jiangsu and Anhui before Fengtian (Zhili clique's Qi Xieyuan, not on the pages) and when Fengtian lost them (the page gives only the 1926 snapshot); (4) whose troops Beijing was taken from in June 1926 and the fact that Guominjun/Zhili share the 1924 gain; (5) the Zhili-Anhui War of 1920 (joint control of Beijing, no territory) was not opened; (6) the Guo Songling revolt moved no border. Counterparts needing dossiers: zhili-clique, anhui-clique, guominjun, shanxi-clique (planned in this batch), 'Sun Chuanfang (Five Provinces Alliance)' (1925-1927, no dossier). Gazetteer: all names resolved; the Shanhaiguan corridor is a six-point polygon (Shanhaiguan is not a place name in the gazetteer).
